svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pipe lengths: 2,703 mm for the two posts on the right (low) side,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2,899 mm for the two on the left (high) side. Square cuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cap plate 150 x 150 x 6 mm, two 11 mm holes 80 mm apart on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: beam line. Weld it to the pipe top tilted 4 degrees, sloping

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: down toward the right side, square to the beam.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 13 mm through the pipe 50 mm above its foot; push a 200 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: length of 12 mm bar through and weld both sides (holds against uplift).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Paint the welds with zinc-rich paint.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Footing: hole 500 x 500 x 600 mm deep, centred 1,850 mm along and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1,400 mm across from the store centre (setting-out plan).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stand the post 450 mm into the hole, plumb, plate tops on a string

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: line: 2,253 mm above ground (right), 2,449 mm (left). Brace, pour.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: plumb both ways; plate tops within 5 mm of the line.
